description_en: Replaces the bandwidth plans of Global Accelerator (GA) instances
description_zh: 调用ReplaceBandwidthPackage接口为全球加速实例替换带宽包
kebab_example: aliyun ga replace-bandwidth-package --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id gbwp-bp176neb61yhcymow0000 --target-bandwidth-package-id gbwp-o978hgeb61yhcymow0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReplaceBandwidthPackage

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the GA instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the required bandwidth plan. When you specify a replacement bandwidth plan, take note of the following items:

Only a bandwidth plan that is not associated with a GA instance can be specified.
If you want to replace a basic bandwidth plan, make sure that the bandwidth provided by the replacement bandwidth plan is not less than the total bandwidth allocated to the acceleration area
parameters.help_zh:
要替换的新的带宽包ID。指定带宽包时，请注意：

仅支持指定未绑定任何全球加速实例的带宽包。

如果要替换的带宽包为基础带宽包，请确保要替换的新的基础带宽包的带宽必须大于或等于加速区域中已分配的带宽总额
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the bandwidth plan that you want to replace
parameters.help_zh: 要被替换的旧的带宽包ID
parameters.name: target_bandwidth_package_id

parameters.help_zh: 待替换带宽包的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id
